== English errata comparison sources ==
The Limited face requires a battle, says any warrior, and checks the target’s ability. Decipher’s November 1998 Glossary changes deployment to your warrior, names character and creature targets, and checks defense value after subtracting distance. The complete errata faces carry the replacement. The Revised article stays in Versions as a separate printing.
